short: Sales after returns, cancellations and discounts.
seoTitle: Net Sales — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Net sales is gross sales minus returns, cancellations and discounts — the revenue a business actually retains from trading.
definition: Net sales is gross sales minus returns, cancellations and discounts — the revenue a business actually retains from trading. It is the figure gross profit is calculated against.
bodyHtml:
Why Net Sales matters

Margin percentages computed on gross sales overstate performance. Net sales is the only base that reflects what customers really paid after everything given back.

Net Sales formula

Net sales = Gross sales − Sales returns − Discounts − Cancellations

This is the denominator for gross margin.

How Net Sales works in practice

Reconcile net sales with the taxable value reported in your GST returns each month. A persistent gap usually points to discounts recorded outside the billing system.

faq.question: Which figure should I use for margin?
faq.answer: Net sales. Using gross sales inflates every margin percentage you report.

faq.question: Do aggregator commissions reduce net sales?
faq.answer: They are usually shown as a cost rather than a deduction from sales, but the contribution view matters more than the presentation.
